levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: the second route «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ... مِثْلَهُ» repeats the saying from another chain after it: a group, not a wording variant
«(ع)» and «(رحمه الله)» are honorifics, left out
the Imams named after «عن» (Abu Abd Allah, Ja'far) stay narrators (owner ruling 2); the final link Husayn is the speaker of the saying
«أَبِي» in the second route is bare: relation
